enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Intelligence +6: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Transform Kinetic Energy: Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that the energy of the blow will be converted into Spell Points.
Rune Arm Charge Rate: 30%: This Rune Arm has a 30% Enhancement bonus to its Charge Rate.

Sovereign Lightning Strike: This item crackles with power, flickers of lightning emanating from it. On a strike of a Natural 20 that is confirmed as a critical hit, this item will strike your foe with a tremendous burst of lightning. A DC 100 Reflex save will prevent half of this damage.
Conduit of the Titans: While wearing two pieces from the Conduit of the Titans set, you gain:

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
Rune Arm Imbue: Electrical VI: Wearing this Rune Arm will imbue any weapon you wield, dealing 2d12 points of Electric damage per hit.
